import_side_effects_static: Top level imports stdlib/msvcrt, reads DESKTOP_CONTROL_DIR, constructs paths/constants/dictionary and threading.Lock. No top-level file opens, OS file locks, request writes, worker-thread starts or UI/COM calls found. This is source analysis only.

api.name: current_owner
api.behavior: Reads owner JSON; adds heartbeat_age_s and stale_suspect after 300 s; owner=None means released. Does not verify OS lock.

api.name: pending_request
api.behavior: Reads request JSON; adds age_s and expired_suspect after max_seconds + 600 s.

api.name: heartbeat
api.behavior: Under process-local mutex, updates in-memory heartbeat and atomically replaces owner JSON; returns False for unknown token.

api.name: holds
api.behavior: Only checks membership in this process-local _held dictionary; does not independently probe OS lock.

api.name: acquire
api.signature: acquire(owner, session, job, timeout=None, request_token=None, poll=0.5)
api.behavior: Polls foreign request, opens permanent lock without truncation, seeks byte 0 and uses LK_NBLCK length 1; stores fd/token, publishes owner, starts daemon heartbeat every 30 s. Optional timeout; does not prove Astris original-job boundary or external authorization.

api.name: release
api.behavior: Pops local token, stops heartbeat, unlocks and closes fd, then publishes owner=None. Returns False for unknown token.

api.name: request
api.behavior: O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY creates request, writes required identity/timing/reason/max_seconds plus pid; returns token or None if existing.

api.name: cancel_request
api.behavior: Reads request, compares token, then removes only REQUEST path; no lock-file removal. Ownership relies on caller retaining its own token.

api.name: wait_request_gone
api.behavior: Waits while request exists and is not expired_suspect; returns for absent or expired request; optional abort/log callbacks.

contract_checks.permanent_lock: PASS_STATIC: LOCK opened O_RDWR|O_CREAT without O_TRUNC; seek(0), LK_NBLCK length 1; no unlink/remove/replace of LOCK present.
contract_checks.owner_atomic_replace: PASS_STATIC: unique temp + os.replace(tmp, OWNER); required owner/session/job/pid/since/heartbeat/token fields present. Release ordering race F1 remains.
contract_checks.request_exclusive: PASS_STATIC: O_EXCL; required fields present. Partial-publication window F4 remains.
contract_checks.request_delete: PASS_STATIC: token equality before os.remove(REQUEST); requester identity is a caller responsibility.
contract_checks.owner_stale: PASS_STATIC: >300 s only stale_suspect flag; no force termination or automatic owner-file removal.
contract_checks.request_expiry: REVIEW_REQUIRED: elapsed max_seconds+600 bypasses pending request without requester deletion (F3).
contract_checks.heartbeat: PASS_STATIC: daemon thread every 30 s; errors swallowed (F5).
contract_checks.upper_queue_boundary: NOT_VERIFIED: this module contains no upper_queue integration; separate caller code and fake test results not reviewed.

findings.issue: release publishes owner=None after dropping the OS lock. Another process may acquire and publish its owner between unlock and this publication; former owner can overwrite the current owner record.
findings.impact: Owner metadata may falsely indicate released while another process holds the OS lock. Mutual exclusion itself still depends on OS lock.
findings.suggested_fix_for_astris: Publish release metadata while still holding the OS lock, then unlock/close; protect failure cleanup with finally. Do not edit shared module from Web HWP.

findings.issue: After LK_NBLCK succeeds and _held is set, owner publication or heartbeat-thread startup can raise without rollback. Caller receives no token, but fd and lock can remain held by this live process.
findings.impact: Caller can time out/fail while process retains an unmanageable lock; heartbeat may never start.
findings.suggested_fix_for_astris: On any post-lock initialization error, stop any started heartbeat, remove local entry, unlock/close fd and re-raise; preserve permanent lock file.

findings.status: observed source policy; requires coordination decision
findings.issue: acquire ignores foreign requests marked expired_suspect and wait_request_gone returns while that request still exists. This bypasses the agreed request-gone boundary based on elapsed time.
findings.impact: Does not steal an active OS lock or delete request, but elapsed time can allow progress without requester cleanup or explicit boundary confirmation.
findings.suggested_fix_for_astris: Treat expiry as diagnostic only, or obtain explicit agreed timeout policy. Keep Web HWP automation disabled until clarified.

findings.issue: request is created before JSON is written; empty/partial/corrupt request reads become None. acquire can interpret an existing request as absent. Request creation can also occur after the pre-lock check.
findings.impact: Requester-priority/safe-boundary fairness is not atomic. OS byte-lock mutual exclusion still holds.
findings.suggested_fix_for_astris: Distinguish absent from unreadable request and fail closed on an existing incomplete file; recheck request after acquiring OS lock before granting UI access.

findings.issue: Heartbeat publication errors are silently swallowed; caller is not informed that metadata heartbeat stopped updating.
findings.impact: OS lock remains authoritative, but monitoring can report stale owner without exposing I/O failure.
findings.suggested_fix_for_astris: Expose/log heartbeat publication failures so coordinator can diagnose; never automatically reclaim a stale lock.
